title: Junior Software Engineer
summary: Build and maintain business web applications with code review and support from the team. Work on small features and investigate issues that customers report.
responsibilities: Implement small features and bug fixes across the interface and API.
Reproduce customer-reported issues and document what you find.
Write or update tests and prepare pull requests for review.
requirements: Hands-on experience building or maintaining a web application through work, an internship, or a substantial project.
Working knowledge of Git, HTTP APIs, and relational databases.
Ability to debug a problem, verify a fix, and explain the change to a reviewer.
niceToHave: Experience with Laravel, React, or customer-facing software support.
